title: Harvest Havoc
description:
Join our Discord

Об игреA unique fusion of farming and slapstick combat, Harvest Havoc is a chaotic online PvP party game for 2-6 players. Grow, harvest, (steal) and sell your crops to win! Fight with your fists or grow some weapons to mess with your friends and aid your crop-stealing mischief. Gather your friends, bring out your inner gremlin and compete to become the ultimate farmer-warrior!Multiplayer for 6Best played with friends, family or co-workers, play with up to 5 other farmer-warriors in online multiplayerGrow, Harvest, Sell!Find the seed packets scattered around the map and plant it to start your farming spree. Be the one to earn the most money. But watch out: farmers might have their eyes on your precious crops.

Steal & Sabotage!Wanna mess around with your friends? Use your fists or grow some weapons to smack them around and steal their crops for yourself!

Teams VS Free-for-allWant to work together? Or is it every farmer for themselves? Choose how you want to play.

Character SelectionChoose your wacky character from a selection of 5 animal costumes and 8 colours.

5 Thematic Maps & 3 Game ModesPlay in a variety of "farms" with different ways to play and navigate each map. If it feels too slow for you or you want more bare-knuckle brawling, try out the different game modes!
description_short: Grow, harvest, (steal) and sell your crops to win! Fight with your fists or grow some weapons to smack your rivals and take their crops. Gather your friends online and compete to become the best farmer-warrior in this chaotic PvP party game.
